name: io.github.cezman/ironharness
description: Safe I/O for LLM agents on real hardware: serial, Modbus, MQTT and ESP32, gated and journaled.

environmentVariables.name: IRONHARNESS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Root for the JSONL journal and file sandbox (default ~/.ironharness).

environmentVariables.name: IRONHARNESS_ALLOW_REAL_FLASH
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in required for live flash/erase of a connected board.
